Type: deco
Name: Black and White Vintage Bike Print in White Frame, 15" x 21"
Colors: Pink
This detailed diagram of an 1893 bicycle structure is a fun, architectural art piece for any room. A modern presentation of a vintage design, this piece will blend with any existing style in your room. Modern print of vintage bicycle blueprint Gold foil printed on paper, encased behind glass in wood frame with white finish 15" x 21" Ready to hang with hardware included. Made to order
